title: omUI (AI Component Library)
shortDescription: A modern AI-powered React component library that provides beautifully designed, customizable UI components developers can download and integrate into their projects within minutes.
whatItSolves: Saves developers hours of UI development by offering production-ready, responsive, and reusable components that can be easily installed, customized, and integrated into any React application.
fullDescription:
Developed omUI, a modern AI-powered component library designed to accelerate frontend development. The platform provides a growing collection of professionally crafted React components, including buttons, cards, forms, navigation bars, modals, dashboards, animations, and more.

Developers can browse components, preview them in real time, copy the source code or install the library directly into their projects. Every component is responsive, customizable, and built with clean, reusable code, enabling faster development without sacrificing design quality.

The platform focuses on delivering a seamless developer experience with modern UI patterns, comprehensive documentation, and easy integration into existing React applications.

title: OMEX AI(AI Notes generator)
shortDescription: An AI-powered notes generator platform with a credit-based usage system, enabling users to generate structured notes instantly.
whatItSolves: Helps students and professionals quickly generate high-quality notes without spending hours researching and writing, while controlling API usage through a credit-based system.
fullDescription:
Built a full-stack AI notes generation platform inspired by ChatGPT, where users can input topics or prompts and receive well-structured, AI-generated notes in real-time.

Implemented a credit-based system to manage and limit usage, simulating real-world SaaS monetization models. The platform includes secure authentication, dynamic prompt handling, markdown rendering, and export to PDF features.

title: omAI
shortDescription: An AI-powered chatbot generator that creates customizable business chatbots and provides an embeddable script tag for seamless website integration.
whatItSolves: Helps businesses deploy AI customer support without building a chatbot from scratch by generating a ready-to-use chatbot that can be embedded into any website using a single script tag.
fullDescription:
Developed a full-stack AI chatbot generator that enables businesses to create intelligent, customizable chatbots by providing their company details, FAQs, or knowledge base. The platform processes this information using AI and generates a unique embeddable JavaScript script tag.

By simply adding the generated script tag to any company website, the chatbot is instantly integrated and can answer customer queries based on the provided business information. The platform features secure authentication, scalable backend services, real-time AI responses, and an intuitive dashboard for managing chatbot configurations.

skillsUsed.Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST API, Script Generation
